title: Free-streaming score identities and a constant mixed-metric obstruction

reported_status: For smooth positive free-streaming densities with the stated finite score integrals,the spatial score is constant and the velocity score is sheared linearly along characteristics. Exact spatial/velocity/cross-score derivative identities follow. Consequently no time-independent positive-definite coercive quadratic form in both scores is non-increasing for EVERY free-streaming solution with nonzero spatial Fisher information. This is an elementary analytic representation/method check,not a new collision theorem or full kinetic impossibility.

located_proof_sources.quote: Separate representation check for kinetic alternatives. For free streaming f_t+v.grad_x f=0, put X=grad_x log f and V=grad_v log f. Along characteristics, X'=0 and V'=-X. Hence I_v'=-2 integral f V.X, (integral f X.V)'=-I_x, and I_x'=0. A time-independent positive-definite quadratic form in (X,V) cannot be non-increasing for every free-streaming solution: V(t)=V(0)-tX(0) makes it unbounded for nonzero X. This excludes a constant coercive mixed-score transport correction as an automatic extension of homogeneous Fisher monotonicity. It excludes neither a time-dependent hypocoercive functional nor the full inhomogeneous kinetic problem.
